title: Asset aging rules in the Agentic SecOps Platform: inactive assets, aging by time or value, affected entities and rule order

age-purpose.statement: Asset aging automatically transitions outdated assets to an inactive state; inactive assets remain available for historical reporting, can be excluded from primary dashboard views, and are not deleted.

quotes: enables organizations to automatically transition outdated or irrelevant assets to an inactive state.
Inactive assets remain available for historical reporting but can be excluded from primary dashboard views.
without deleting the asset from the platform

age-categories.statement: Aging rules have two categories: aging by time (days since the asset was last detected, using the Asset Last Seen field) and aging by value (source-system updates indicating status changes or other field data).

quotes: Aging by time: Age assets based on the number of days since they were last detected by integrated tools or systems (using the Asset Last Seen field).
Aging by value: Age assets based on updates from the source system indicating status changes or other relevant field data.

age-fallback.statement: Asset aging includes a fallback rule with a default value and no conditional logic; it can be edited but not removed or deleted.

quotes: Asset aging includes a fallback rule that specifies a default value with no conditional logic.
The fallback rule can be edited, but can't be removed or deleted.

age-role.statement: Asset aging requires a role with Read, Create and Edit permissions under the Platform - Model Management resource.

quotes: your assigned role must include the Read, Create, and Edit permissions under the Platform - Model Management resource

age-affected-entities.statement: Affected Entities selects the related entities to age when the asset becomes inactive, and the page says the platform currently supports the aging of findings through asset aging rules; findings are set to Undetected, and resurfacing an asset resurfaces its previously aged findings.

quotes: findings linked to an asset are automatically aged (i.e., set to Undetected) when the asset they are in becomes inactive.
The Agentic SecOps Platform currently supports the aging of findings through asset aging rules.
If an asset is resurfaced, its previously aged findings are also resurfaced.
From the Affected Entities drop-down menu, select related entities that should be automatically aged when their associated asset becomes inactive.

age-findings-independent.statement: Findings are aged by asset aging and by the remediation detection settings independently, and satisfying either is sufficient to age the findings.

quotes: The aging of findings through asset aging and the aging of findings through remediation detection settings are evaluated independently, and satisfying either of the configured aging settings is sufficient to age the findings.

age-rule-order.statement: Asset aging rule order does not affect application order; each data point is evaluated against all rules even after one is satisfied.

quotes: The rules' order of appearance doesn't affect the order of their application. Each data point is evaluated against all rules, even if one rule has already been satisfied.
